title: [AUG-147] Move audio extraction out of the upload request so long videos never hang on "Starting transcription…"
why_we_need_this: The upload endpoint in @server/src/routes/sessions.ts runs ensureWav (ffmpeg extraction, up to 600 s for video since AUG-144) and ffprobe before it responds, so the UI sits on "Starting transcription…" with no progress. Node's default HTTP requestTimeout is 300 s and the server does not change it (inferred from code), so a slow extraction can cut the request while ffmpeg keeps running, leaving the user with an error for a session that may still finish. Responding immediately and extracting in the background makes long videos predictable.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] The single-track upload responds right after the file is saved to the session folder (status 201), without waiting for ensureWav/getAudioDuration.
- [ ] Extraction runs in the background job; the session shows a distinct "preparing audio" phase in the UI (new status or sub-state) until whisper starts, then the Chronometer Ring appears with duration and estimatedDuration set as soon as they are known.
- [ ] Extraction failures (no audio track, unreadable video, ffmpeg missing) still put the session into failed with the same user-facing messages and "Transcribe again".
- [ ] Cancel works during the preparing phase and kills the ffmpeg process.
- [ ] Retranscribe follows the same flow; audio uploads, dual-track and capture uploads keep working (dual-track may stay synchronous if documented).
- [ ] Verified with a ≥30 min video: the upload request returns in seconds, the phase is visible, the transcript completes; timing noted in the card.
- [ ] project-context/transcription/README.md updated: the "timer metadata set before responding" invariant is rewritten for the new phase, and the old line is removed rather than left alongside.
important_constraints:
- Changes the existing invariant "timer metadata must be set in the endpoint before responding" — the replacement rule must keep the Chronometer Ring from missing its first render.
- Session status values are shared with the client; update types on both sides and keep old session.json files readable.
- orphan recovery (recoverOrphanedSessions) must also cover the new phase.
- Both platforms; ffmpeg via config.ffmpegPath only.
- Related: AUG-144.
